decision_rule: Rebuild the KB-RAG index under the qd-v2 convention (encoder gte-moderncolbert-v1-onnx model_int8.onnx, doc cap 256) into the FRESH dir data/kb_rag/index-qd-v2; index-qd-v1 and index are never touched. PASS = catalog chunk rows == manifest chunks AND index_meta.prefix_convention == qd-v2 AND a query for 'DeepSeek V4.1 Flash evaluation' returns handoffs/active/deepseek-v41-flash-evaluation.md in its top 10. FAIL otherwise. Stop-on-answer: all four units once; stop-on-futility: encode rc != 0 or precond refusal (disk floor 150 GiB). Resumable.
width_justification: 24 workers x 1 ONNX thread = one quarter; encode scales to ~48 workers (185 chunk/s measured 2026-08-12) but a 40k-chunk rebuild is ~10 min on a quarter, so it does not widen and packs beside other quarters.
notes: Orchestrator code: branch apr/kb-qd-v2-20261109 @ e5add69f (worktree pinned by the job). Cutover (repointing consumers) is a separate step after PASS.
